name: Tactical Precision
body:
School divination; Level bard 3, psychic 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a soldier figurine)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw yes (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You create a bond of empathic understanding between the target creatures, allowing them insight into each other’s actions. If two subjects of this spell flank the same creature, each gains a +2 insight bonus on their melee attack rolls against the flanked enemy and an extra 1d6 damage. The extra damage is considered precision damage.
